other_failure_modes.name: TestLeakageFeatureEngineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes feature encodings (e.g., frequency encoding) using the combined train and test datasets, leaking information about the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The agent correctly formulates the ordinal classification problem as a regression task followed by Nelder-Mead threshold optimization, which is an excellent approach for the QWK metric. However, the agent relies on a naive unweighted average for ensembling their two models, and introduces data leakage by using the test dataset to compute frequency encodings for RescuerID.
